crossRefs.note: “Keep your feet from being bare, and your throat from thirst. But you said, ‘It is in vain. No, for I have loved…
While he was still talking with them, behold, the messenger came down to him. Then he said, “Behold, this evil is from…
You were wearied with the length of your ways; yet you didn’t say, ‘It is in vain.’ You found a reviving of your…
Then he said to me, “Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel. Behold, they say, ‘Our bones are dried up…
At that time they will call Jerusalem ‘Yahweh’s Throne;’ and all the nations will be gathered to it, to Yahweh’s name…
But they didn’t listen or turn their ear, but walked in their own counsels and in the stubbornness of their evil heart…
Yet they didn’t obey, nor turn their ear, but everyone walked in the stubbornness of their evil heart. Therefore I…
You have done evil more than your fathers, for behold, you each walk after the stubbornness of his evil heart, so that…
They say continually to those who despise me, ‘Yahweh has said, “You will have peace;” ’ and to everyone who walks in…
But we will certainly perform every word that has gone out of our mouth, to burn incense to the queen of the sky, and…
Yahweh saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of man’s heart…
Yahweh smelled the pleasant aroma. Yahweh said in his heart, “I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake…
and it happen, when he hears the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying, “I shall have peace…
For from within, out of the hearts of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, sexual sins, murders, thefts,
covetings, wickedness, deceit, lustful desires, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, and foolishness.
He has shown strength with his arm. He has scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.

translations.web: But they say, ‘It is in vain; for we will walk after our own plans, and we will each follow the stubbornness of his evil heart.’ ”
translations.bsb: But they will reply, ‘It is hopeless. We will follow our own plans, and each of us will act according to the stubbornness of his evil heart.’”
translations.kjv: And they said, There is no hope: but we will walk after our own devices, and we will every one do the imagination of his evil heart.
translations.asv: But they say, It is in vain; for we will walk after our own devices, and we will do every one after the stubbornness of his evil heart.
